The plate is roughly 26 cm across, and the bar is about 8 cm long and 2 cm wide. It is about 1.5 cm high, which gives a volume of roughly 24 cm³. Granola and cereal bars are fairly dense but airy, so I estimated about 0.6 g/cm³, which comes to about 15 g. The bar has a thin chocolate drizzle, so I estimated 2 g for that and listed it separately. A granola bar is about 420 kcal/100 g, and chocolate drizzle about 500 kcal/100 g.
